title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 3)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 3), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture discusses the theological positions of Ibn Taymiyya regarding divine attributes in relation to anthropomorphism.
